trials.claim: AI Engine is currently only available for standard WordPress posts
trials.claimQuote: The AI Engine is currently available for standard WordPress posts.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is nothing to confirm or contradict it.

trials.claim: Automatically links related posts to boost SEO and engage users
trials.claimQuote: Automatically link related posts to boost SEO and engage users with relevant content.
trials.reasoning: Two reviews confirm the plugin automatically links related content and inserts automated internal links to help visitors navigate. The prosecution review limits how it chooses links, but does not show that automatic related-post linking does not happen.

exhibits.quote: It won't link by taxonomy, tags, or published date. It won't do more than (or fewer than) 2 posts.
exhibits.argument: Review reports core automatic linking by taxonomy/tags failed and was stuck on defaults, undermining automatic SEO linking claim.

exhibits.quote: The dashboard for this plugin is complicated and difficult to use.
exhibits.argument: Review indicates the automatic linking is not simple to configure, contradicting seamless automatic engagement benefit.

exhibits.quote: I love how it automatically links related content within my site, making it easier for visitors to navigate and find more valuable information.
exhibits.argument: Review confirms plugin automatically links related content and helps visitors navigate, supporting SEO and engagement benefit.

exhibits.quote: Excellent tool for inserting automated internal links into your posts.
exhibits.argument: Review confirms the plugin automatically inserts internal links as claimed.

trials.claim: Automatically inserts related posts inside content using categories, keywords, titles, or AI analysis
trials.claimQuote: Automatically insert related posts directly inside your content using categories, keywords, titles, or AI-powered content analysis.
trials.reasoning: Reviews report it would not link by taxonomy or tags and would not create links using existing copy. This directly conflicts with inserting related posts using categories, keywords, titles, or similar analysis, and no defense exhibit supports that claim.

exhibits.quote: It won't link by taxonomy, tags, or published date. It won't do more than (or fewer than) 2 posts.
exhibits.argument: Directly contradicts claim of automatic insertion using categories/keywords/titles as those methods did not work.

exhibits.quote: I wanted something that creates links using existing copy, but it does not do that.
exhibits.argument: Shows insertion does not work as expected on existing content, undermining automatic inside-content insertion claim.

trials.claim: Supports OpenAI, Ollama, WooCommerce products, shortcodes, custom layouts and click statistics
trials.claimQuote: Supports OpenAI, Ollama, WooCommerce products, shortcodes, and custom layouts, with optional click statistics.
trials.reasoning: The generic disclaimer about third-party compatibility and a wish for post-to-page linking do not directly prove or disprove support for OpenAI, Ollama, WooCommerce products, shortcodes, layouts, or click statistics. No exhibit directly addresses most of those features.

exhibits.quote: We do not guarantee compatibility with any additional third party plugins, scripts, or applications.
exhibits.argument: Vendor disclaims guarantee for third-party integrations like OpenAI/Ollama/WooCommerce, undermining support claim.

exhibits.quote: It is nicely linking for the post to post types. wish it will do the same for the post to pages also.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports linking limited to post-to-post, contradicting broad support for WooCommerce products/pages and custom layouts.
